name: Kronberg im Taunus (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and blue, charged above the centre with the city arms of Kronberg im Taunus (a yellow crown above a black fir cone on blue and white).
history: The colours gold for the crown and black for the fir cone have been officially approved since 1907.

features.role: Kronberg arms — crown and fir cone
